identity.title: Local-First CI Cost Optimization
identity.objective: Reduce hosted GitHub Actions frequency by suppressing the existing expensive CI matrix while pull requests are draft, requiring local-first validation and a stable candidate before Ready-for-review, preserving the complete final hosted compatibility/audit matrix on the exact non-draft head, removing the duplicate push-to-main full matrix, and retaining fresh exact-head CI after any later source change.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-CI-OPT-01. The prior ci.yml pull-request and push-to-main trigger frequency plus prior validation/drafting guidance return. No product source, dependency, credential, runtime, execution, live, capital, or persistent product state is changed or migrated.

api_matrix.reason: This WP changes only GitHub Actions scheduling semantics and canonical development-workflow guidance; product/runtime APIs remain unchanged.

items.before: The full hosted matrix is eligible on every pull_request activity and runs again after merge through push to main.
items.after: Draft pull requests suppress all expensive jobs; the unchanged full matrix is eligible on final non-draft pull-request heads, with fresh exact-head CI after later non-draft source changes; push-to-main duplication is removed.
items.compatibility_requirement: Final exact-head coverage remains the same nine hosted jobs and every current job body/matrix/test/audit requirement is preserved.

items.before: Hosted CI may be triggered repeatedly while implementation is still changing.
items.after: Focused and broad/full validation is local-first; the PR remains draft while changing and hosted CI is reserved for the stable exact final candidate under normal operation.
items.compatibility_requirement: Any source change after a hosted PASS requires fresh exact-head hosted CI before Ready YES.
No src, dependency, credential, scheduler, strategy, paper, execution, live, or product-network behavior changes.

semantic_fields.reason: The CI trigger, draft suppression, concurrency, local-first validation, final hosted evidence, matrix preservation, infrastructure rerun, and product-authority boundaries are deterministic governance semantics.

items.required_rule: pull_request final-head evidence only; duplicate push-to-main full matrix removed
items.validation_rule: pull_request covers opened synchronize reopened ready_for_review and the workflow contains no push-to-main trigger

items.required_rule: all current top-level expensive jobs are ineligible while pull_request.draft is true
items.validation_rule: each current top-level job has an equivalent draft-false condition

items.required_rule: same-PR stale workflow runs are cancelled when a newer eligible head appears
items.validation_rule: concurrency groups by pull-request identity and cancel-in-progress is true

items.required_rule: focused and iterative validation is local; one authoritative local broad/full suite runs on the stable candidate before Ready-for-review
items.validation_rule: canonical drafting and validation docs state local-first draft-until-stable behavior

items.required_rule: normal path uses one complete hosted matrix on the stable non-draft final head; any later source change invalidates old hosted evidence
items.validation_rule: ready_for_review and non-draft synchronize remain eligible and docs require fresh exact-head CI after changes

items.required_rule: the existing five top-level jobs and nine expanded hosted jobs retain current OS Python audit frontend NDFD strict and full-suite coverage
items.validation_rule: focused workflow test asserts required job names matrix literals strict DuckDB and full pytest remain

items.required_rule: on unchanged-head hosted infrastructure cancellation rerun only affected jobs where supported rather than restarting green jobs
items.validation_rule: canonical validation guidance records affected-job-only rerun policy and distinguishes pre-run cancellation from code failure

items.required_rule: no product source runtime dependency credential scheduler strategy paper execution live or capital authority
items.validation_rule: exact scope contains only workflow governance docs tests status and package artifacts and all product authority booleans remain false
